title: Auto Loans: Base APR and Credit Grade Rate Card
content:
Piedmont Crescent Bank prices every Auto Loans product from a base annual percentage rate that depends on the chosen term, a grade adder that depends on the credit grade underwriting assigns, and a floor under which discounts can never push the rate.

## Base APR by term (percent, before grade adders and discounts)

| Loan product | 36 months | 48 months | 60 months | 72 months | 84 months |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 7.49 | 7.74 | 7.99 | 8.49 | not offered |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 6.74 | 6.99 | 7.24 | 7.74 | not offered |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 6.99 | 7.24 | 7.49 | 7.99 | not offered |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 6.89 | 7.14 | 7.39 | not offered | not offered |
| New Vehicle Loan | 5.99 | 6.24 | 6.49 | 6.99 | 7.49 |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 5.49 | 5.74 | 5.99 | 6.49 | 6.99 |

## Credit grade adders (percentage points added to the base APR)

| Loan product | Grade A | Grade B | Grade C | Grade D |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 0.00 | 1.50 | 3.50 | 6.00 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 0.00 | 1.25 | 3.00 | 5.50 |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 0.00 | 1.25 | 3.00 | 5.50 |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 0.00 | 1.25 | 3.00 | 5.50 |
| New Vehicle Loan | 0.00 | 1.25 | 3.00 | 5.50 |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 0.00 | 1.25 | 3.00 | 5.50 |

## APR floor (percent)

| Loan product | APR floor |
|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 4.49 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 4.49 |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 4.49 |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 4.49 |
| New Vehicle Loan | 3.99 |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 3.49 |

## Notes on the card

- Adders are stated in percentage points and are added to the base figure for the term, so a grade A loan carries the base figure unchanged.
- The floor marks the level below which discounts are never allowed to take a loan's rate.

## Lookup illustration (hypothetical loan)

A hypothetical Green Vehicle Loan on a 72-month term with grade C reads 6.49 from the base table and 3.00 from the adder table, and its floor is 3.49. The loan in this lookup is invented; it shows only where each figure sits on the card.
